SOURCE REVIEW (structure satisfies the staged test.sh contract, items 1-8). tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa for both; diff empty), as are tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, tests/Dockerfile and .dockerignore; task.toml differs from the template only in name/description/keywords/metadata. LF line endings, shebang '#!/bin/bash', `bash -n` clean. (1) Zero first / every exit path: test.sh:60 `write_zero_reward` and :61 `trap cleanup EXIT` precede every grading step; cleanup calls `ensure_reward` (:39, :20-23). Only mkdir/chmod of the log dir (:10-12) come earlier, and a failure there leaves nowhere to write a reward anyway. Because the zero is on disk before any work, a `set -e` abort (e.g. cp at :92) or an external SIGKILL at the verifier timeout still leaves reward.txt=0.0. ZERO_REWARD_JSON (:8) carries reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op. No shell `exec`: the only match is find's `-exec chmod` at :86. (2) Safe launch: missing /app/server.js exits with the zero (:68-70); any symlink outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it exits with the zero (:72-83; the loop reads from process substitution so `exit` leaves the script, not a subshell). (3) /app copied to /tmp/submission (:90-95); app launched with `setsid env -i` carrying exactly PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH under `setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups` (:104-111). umask 077 (:3), log dir 700 (:11) and /tests go-rwx (:12, Dockerfile:44) keep the unprivileged app away from reward files, app.pid and the rubric. (4) Liveness: probe_ready tries /api/health then / (:42-58), up to 120 attempts (:115-122), and exits with the zero when never ready (:123-125), before any RewardKit call. (5) Restart helper by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, exported APP_RESTART_HELPER (:127-193). (6) {app_context} substituted into /tests/*/*/prompt.md (:195-201); tests/app_context.md exists (31 lines). (7) `run_suite gates 1500` (:213) then score.py (:217) with 0 continue / 1 exit keeping the detailed record / other -> write_zero_reward (:218-222). (8) `run_suite scored 11100` (:224) then `score.py || write_zero_reward` (:227). Budgets nest: gate judges 600+600=1200 < 1500; scored judges 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < [verifier].timeout_sec 13200 (unchanged from template). The golden meets the launch assumptions: solve.sh:35 copies app to /app with no symlinks in the tree; bootstrap.js:20,43 answers /api/health and listens on PORT; db.js:13 honours DB_PATH.

LOCAL EXECUTION (host Git Bash and host Python, NOT the verifier image and NOT a configured judge run): qc/runs/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r2/per-row-review/evidence/21/local-simulation.log (sha256 e75fd6af5a9633d920c54d8988cb43d2f94dd6ab50ed7338523f5a5603ce9358). A: REWARDKIT vars unset -> exit 0, reward.txt 0.0, zero JSON with no_op 1. B: vars set, /app/server.js absent -> exit 0, reward.txt 0.0, reward.json and ctrf.json present. score.py with synthetic suite outputs: no gates reward.json -> exit 2; malformed gates JSON -> exit 2; a failed gate -> exit 1 with detailed record reward 0.0; gates pass with scored absent -> exit 0, reward 0.0000; gates pass with scored 0.5/0.5/0.75 -> reward 0.5500; scored missing a dimension -> exit 2; functional exactly at the 0.05 floor -> reward 0.0000 with weighted_score 0.43. Each exit code maps to the test.sh branch described above.

NOT MEASURED (why risk=true): raw-evidence-index.json states that full configured grading/workload is absent and lists only scripted golden browser/API runs. No record shows this candidate's test.sh executed in the verifier image: the unprivileged launch, symlink refusal, liveness timeout, restart helper, both rewardkit suites and the timeout branches are source-verified only. REVIEW_POLICY requires a hash-bound full verifier launch/grading record before local clearance; this Pass does not waive it.

OBSERVATIONS (template-controlled, no task defect, no edit proposed since test.sh is shared harness): (a) if the scored suite times out or rewardkit exits non-zero, test.sh:224-226 exits keeping the gates-stage record (reward 0.0, graded 1, no_op 0) rather than the plain zero that staged-task-contract item 8 describes; the reward value is still 0.0, but a judge/infrastructure failure in the scored stage is recorded as a graded zero, so such a run must be read from scored/rewardkit.log and not treated as a model score. (b) probe_ready accepts any HTTP response, including an error status, as live, and the golden's bootstrap answers /api/health before its worker finishes initialising; excluding a live-but-broken app is the gates' job, not this row's. (c) the readiness loop allows about 30 seconds when connections are refused; a conforming app that boots more slowly gets the zero. The golden's health listener is independent of SQLite initialisation, so it is not exposed, but its boot time inside the verifier was not measured here.
